newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris court to hear Eurotunnel case.
newsitem.headline: Paris court to hear Eurotunnel case.

text.p: The Paris appeal court will hear on September 1 a case brought by Adacte, a dissident group of small shareholders in Eurotunnel SA /Plc, Adacte's lawyer Georges Berlioz told Reuters on Thursday.

The shareholders group has launched a legal action appealing against a May 28 decision by the Council of Financial Markets regulator that Eurotunnel's creditor banks are not acting in concert in the company's debt restrucuring and that they are not obliged to launch a takeover offer, he said.
Under the terms of the restructuring plan, the 174 lenders would get 45.5 percent of Eurotunnel's capital.
